newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline subsides after early gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline subsides after early gains.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices subsided on Tuesday after two prompt cargo buyers were covered and an early rally on NYMEX futures was reversed, traders said.

Two prompt eurograde cargo buyers, one into Gdansk and the other in the Thames, were covered late on Monday, one of them at quotes fob high +$2.00 fob UK. Other cargo requirements were heard in Hamburg and Poland again, but trade was quiet.
Premium unleaded barges traded actively as high as $235.00 fob ARA early, before closing with a $232 offer. The discount for regular unleaded was talked around $10 per tonne.
